+    (340, 618), (325, 631), (310, 644), (294, 656), (278, 668),
+    (262, 679), (246, 690), (230, 700), (222, 704),
+]
+STROKE_2 = [
+    (478, 457), (495, 474), (506, 490), (518, 506), (531, 522),
+    (543, 538), (556, 553), (569, 569), (582, 584), (595, 599),
+    (609, 614), (623, 629), (638, 643), (653, 657), (669, 669),
+    (685, 681), (702, 690), (720, 695), (739, 698), (758, 700),
+    (778, 703), (798, 705), (817, 708), (821, 708),
+]
+
+
+def path_in_image(points: list[tuple[int, int]], edt: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
+    """Return target-aligned (world x, world y, brush-tip z) targets."""
+    p = np.asarray(points, dtype=np.float64)
+    ds = np.linalg.norm(np.diff(p, axis=0), axis=1)
+    s = np.r_[0.0, np.cumsum(ds)]
+    x_of_s = PchipInterpolator(s, p[:, 0])
+    y_of_s = PchipInterpolator(s, p[:, 1])
+    px_step = 1.5 / MM_PER_PX
+    arc = np.r_[np.arange(0.0, s[-1], px_step), s[-1]]
+    u, v = x_of_s(arc), y_of_s(arc)
+
+    # The half-coverage exemplar boundary is close to the image's mid-tone.
+    radius_px = map_coordinates(edt, [v, u], order=1, mode="nearest")
+    mark_width_mm = gaussian_filter1d(2.0 * radius_px * MM_PER_PX, sigma=2.0)
+
+    # Practice sheet: at 8.2 mm compression a moving stroke averaged about
+    # 9 mm wide.  This local linear fit gives the exemplar's light ends and
+    # broad lower-right flourish without filling the shapes.
+    press_mm = np.clip((mark_width_mm + 0.6) / 1.2, 1.8, 13.0)
+    z = PAPER_Z - press_mm / 1000.0
+
+    # Pixel-to-paper axes follow the canvas: u increases toward world -y,
+    # v increases toward world -x.  The camera is centered on the sheet.
+    local_x_m = (u + 0.5) * MM_PER_PX / 1000.0
+    local_y_m = (v + 0.5) * MM_PER_PX / 1000.0
+    world_x = SHEET_ORIGIN_X - local_y_m
+    world_y = SHEET_ORIGIN_Y - local_x_m
+    return np.c_[world_x, world_y, z]
+
+
+def get_paths() -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
+    rgb = np.asarray(Image.open(TARGET).convert("RGB"), dtype=np.uint8)
+    mask = rgb.mean(axis=2) < 128
+    edt = ndi.distance_transform_edt(mask)
+    return path_in_image(STROKE_1, edt), path_in_image(STROKE_2, edt)
+
+
+def measured_pose(r: Robot) -> np.ndarray:
+    return np.asarray(r.get_obs(video="none").meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)[7:14]
+
+
+def send_xyz_rows(r: Robot, destination: np.ndarray, n: int, note: str) -> np.ndarray:
+    start = measured_pose(r)
+    q = start[3:].copy()
+    end = np.r_[np.asarray(destination, dtype=float), q]
+    rows = np.asarray([start + (end - start) * (i / n) for i in range(1, n + 1)], dtype=np.float32)
+    res = r.submit("ee_pose", rows, dt=0.05, video="none", note=note)
+    if res.meta.get("stopped"):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"service stopped during {note}: {res.meta['stopped']}")
+    return np.asarray(res.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)[7:14]
+
+
+def hold_pose(r: Robot, pose: np.ndarray, n: int, note: str) -> np.ndarray:
+    rows = np.tile(np.asarray(pose, dtype=np.float32), (n, 1))
+    res = r.submit("ee_pose", rows, dt=0.05, video="none", note=note)
+    if res.meta.get("stopped"):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"service stopped during {note}: {res.meta['stopped']}")
+    return np.asarray(res.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)[7:14]
+
+
+def command_path(r: Robot, xyz: np.ndarray, note: str) -> np.ndarray:
+    q = measured_pose(r)[3:]
+    rows = np.c_[xyz, np.tile(q, (len(xyz), 1))].astype(np.float32)
+    res = r.submit("ee_pose", rows, dt=0.05, video="none", note=note)
+    if res.meta.get("stopped"):
+        raise RuntimeError(f"service stopped during {note}: {res.meta['stopped']}")
+    return np.asarray(res.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)[7:14]
+
+
+def write_first(r: Robot) -> None:
+    first, _ = get_paths()
+    start = first[0].copy()
+    # Transit over the main sheet stays well above its surface.
+    send_xyz_rows(r, np.r_[start[:2], 0.15], 48, "approach first stroke")
+    # Lowering at a moderate rate needs a short settling hold before the path.
+    pose = send_xyz_rows(r, start, 26, "press at first-stroke head")
+    pose = hold_pose(r, pose, 16, "settle first-stroke contact")
+    pose = command_path(r, first[1:], "main stroke 1: left-falling path")
+    pose = hold_pose(r, pose, 3, "finish first-stroke tail")
+    pose = send_xyz_rows(r, [pose[0], pose[1], 0.14], 14, "lift after first stroke")
+    send_xyz_rows(r, [-0.1, 0.24, 0.35], 40, "park clear of canvas")
+    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=["canvas_cam"], video="none")
+    Image.fromarray(obs.last["canvas_cam"]).save(OUT / "after_first_canvas.png")
+    print("first stroke complete", r.status(), "tip", measured_pose(r)[:3])
+
+
+def dip_at_well(r: Robot) -> None:
+    send_xyz_rows(r, [WELL_XY[0], WELL_XY[1], 0.12], 38, "approach ink well")
+    pose = send_xyz_rows(r, [WELL_XY[0], WELL_XY[1], 0.025], 20, "dip brush")
+    pose = hold_pose(r, pose, 8, "load brush")
+    send_xyz_rows(r, [WELL_XY[0], WELL_XY[1], 0.14], 20, "lift from ink well")
+
+
+def write_second(r: Robot) -> None:
+    _, second = get_paths()
+    dip_at_well(r)  # restores the point before the second calligraphy stroke
+    start = second[0].copy()
+    send_xyz_rows(r, np.r_[start[:2], 0.15], 48, "approach second stroke")
+    pose = send_xyz_rows(r, start, 26, "press at second-stroke head")
+    pose = hold_pose(r, pose, 12, "settle second-stroke contact")
+    pose = command_path(r, second[1:], "main stroke 2: right-falling path")
+    hold_pose(r, pose, 3, "finish second-stroke tail")
+    pose = measured_pose(r)
+    send_xyz_rows(r, [pose[0], pose[1], 0.15], 14, "lift after second stroke")
+    send_xyz_rows(r, [-0.1, 0.24, 0.35], 40, "park clear of canvas")
+    obs = r.get_obs(cameras=["canvas_cam"], video="none")
+    Image.fromarray(obs.last["canvas_cam"]).save(OUT / "final_canvas.png")
+    print("second stroke complete", r.status(), "tip", measured_pose(r)[:3])
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    r = Robot()
+    action = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "first"
+    if action == "first":
+        write_first(r)
+    elif action == "second":
+        write_second(r)
+    else:
+        raise SystemExit("usage: gen.py [first|second]")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
